messages.author: 7adf342b440b6635
messages.subject: LDSC  step error
parts:
Dear Genomics SEM Users,

I’m trying to run a multivariate GWAS using GenomicSEM. after the munjging step, I got this message: “The file is saved as.sumstats.gz in the current working directory.” But there is no file saved in my directory,also, I got an error in the LDSC step.


CODES:

 

traits<-c("Narrowing_rsid_updated.tsv", "Marrow_rsid_updated.tsv","Herniation_rsid_updated.tsv","ForaminalStenosis_rsid_updated.tsv","EndplateDefect_rsid_updated.tsv"))

sample.prev <- c(NA,NA,NA,NA,NA) # I even try to use (1,1,1,1,1) but same error I got#

population.prev <-c(NA,NA,NA,NA,NA)

ld <- "eur_w_ld_chr/"

wld <- "eur_w_ld_chr/"

trait.names<-c("Narrowing", "Marrow", "Herniation", "ForaminalStenosis", "EndplateDefect")

LDSC_INT<-ldsc(traits=traits, sample.prev=sample.prev, population.prev=population.prev, ld=ld, wld=wld,trait.names=trait.names)

 

ERROR:

Estimating heritability [1/3] for: Narrowing_rsid_updated.tsv

Error in h(simpleError(msg, call)) :

  error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function 't': non-conformable arguments

I will appreciate your help.

Maryam

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: LDSC step error
parts:
Hi Maryam, 

The traits listed in the LDSC step should be the munged files (with the .sumstats.gz file ending). It looks like you are providing the original GWAS files, which is throwing the error. If you are unable to find the files being created by the prior munge step I would suggest being sure to set your working directory prior to running that piece of code. 

Best, 
  Andrew
